definitions.explanation: A person who designs the physical appearance of a book — its cover, binding, paper, and overall layout. A specialized creative profession in publishing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{装丁家|そうていか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{表紙|ひょうし}→表紙：04351_hyoushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手|て}がけた→手がける：12753_tegakeru⟧。
examples.english: A famous book designer worked on the cover.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美|うつく}しさ→美しさ：27922_utsukushisa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{装丁家|そうていか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: The beauty of this book is thanks to the book designer.

examples.japanese: {装丁家|そうていか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質感|しつかん}→質感：18028_shitsukan⟧や⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: A book designer thinks carefully about everything down to the texture of the paper and the placement of the type.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{装丁|そうてい}→装丁：15665_soutei⟧ (book design, binding) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (specialist; -ist). Refers to a professional who designs books.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {装丁家|そうていか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}がける→手がける：12753_tegakeru⟧: a book designer works on (a book)
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{装丁家|そうていか}: a popular book designer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{装丁|そうてい}→装丁：15665_soutei⟧: book design; binding — the work itself, not the person.
- ⟦デザイナー→デザイナー：05061_dezainaa⟧: designer — the general loanword, not specific to books.
